# Budget Car Rental

> > Budget Car Rental offers affordable vehicle rentals across the USA and internationally, with a diverse fleet including Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, and Dodge vehicles, plus flexible rental options from one-day to long-term leases.

Budget provides comprehensive car rental services with insurance protection options (LDW, PAE), cross-border travel capabilities, and specialized services for driving tests and monthly rentals. The site features travel guides for popular USA destinations including Colorado, Pacific Coast Highway, and California routes.

## Key Topics

- Budget Car Rental
- Vehicle rental services
- Toyota, Honda, Hyundai, Dodge fleet
- LDW (Loss Damage Waiver)
- Cross-border rentals (USA-Canada)
- DMV driving test rentals
- Long-term and monthly rentals
- SUV and hybrid vehicles
- International Driving Permit
- Road trip planning
- Pacific Coast Highway (California State Route 1)
- Rental insurance and protections
- Age and license requirements
- Colorado, San Francisco, San Diego destinations

## Rental Services & Options

- [Rental Car Insurance Coverage](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/protections): Insurance coverage options including LDW and PAE protection plans
- [Long Term & Monthly Car Rental](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/services/long-term-car-rental): Monthly and extended car rental service with unlimited mileage options
- [One-Day Car Rental—Cheap Rates](https://www.budget.com/en/products-services/services/one-day-car-rental): Daily car rental service for short-term business and personal trips

## Vehicle Fleet

- [Dodge Durango Rental & Similar SUVs](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/dodge/durango): Dodge Durango SUV rental details and booking for 7-seater vehicles
- [Save on Toyota Rentals](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/toyota): Toyota rental fleet including Sienna, 4Runner, and hybrid vehicles
- [Toyota Camry Rental & Similar Cars](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/toyota/camry): Toyota Camry full-size sedan rental with comfort and safety features
- [Save on Honda Rentals](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/honda): Honda vehicle fleet including Civic, HR-V, and Accord rental options
- [Save on Hyundai Rental Cars](https://www.budget.com/en/cars/hyundai): Hyundai sedan and SUV rentals including Elantra and Kona models
